headword: {弾劾裁判|だんがいさいばん}

definitions.explanation: A formal judicial proceeding to remove a public official from office for misconduct. In Japan, this specifically refers to the trial of judges by the Judge Impeachment Court established under the Constitution.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弾劾裁判|だんがいさいばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かけられた。
examples.english: That judge was subjected to an impeachment trial.

examples.japanese: {弾劾裁判|だんがいさいばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国会議員|こっかいぎいん}→国会議員：20949_kokkaigiin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Impeachment trials are conducted by a court composed of members of the Diet.

examples.japanese: {弾劾裁判|だんがいさいばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{罷免|ひめん}→罷免：29397_himen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{法曹|ほうそう}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A judge dismissed through an impeachment trial may lose their legal professional qualification.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{弾劾|だんがい}→弾劾：20520_dangai⟧ (impeachment) and ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧ (trial). In Japan's legal system, the {弾劾裁判所|だんがいさいばんしょ} (Judge Impeachment Court) is a special body prescribed by Article 64 of the Constitution that handles the removal of judges.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弾劾裁判|だんがいさいばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ — to subject someone to an impeachment trial
- {弾劾裁判|だんがいさいばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ — to open/hold an impeachment trial
- {弾劾裁判|だんがいさいばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{罷免|ひめん}→罷免：29397_himen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to dismiss through impeachment
- {弾劾裁判所|だんがいさいばんしょ} — the Impeachment Court

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{弾劾|だんがい}→弾劾：20520_dangai⟧ — impeachment (the accusation or charge itself)
- ⟦{罷免|ひめん}→罷免：29397_himen⟧ — dismissal from office
- {訴追|そつい} — prosecution; bringing charges
- {裁判官訴追委員会|さいばんかんそついいいんかい} — Judge Indictment Committee (the body that decides whether to bring impeachment charges)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's impeachment system targets only judges, unlike some countries where presidents or other officials can be impeached. The {弾劾裁判所|だんがいさいばんしょ} consists of 14 Diet members (7 from each house). Impeachment cases are rare; only a handful of judges have been removed since the system was established in 1947.
